description: Except catches a failed reading and falls back to a default
A bare except binds the error to error as catch does
Except Exception as a name binds the thrown value as it was thrown
A failed body rolls back before its except clause runs
code:
stock = 10
reserved = stock - 2
try:
    stock = 3
    throw "SHORT"
except Exception as reason:
    note = reason
[stock, reserved, note]

description: An error raised in an except clause reaches the enclosing one
A finally clause runs after an except clause
code:
log = []
try:
    throw "X"
except Exception as e:
    log.push(e)
finally:
    log.push("done")
log

try: total = price * 2
except: total = 0
total

description: Except follows a colon-free try header
code:
try
    total = count + 1
except Exception as e:
    total = 0
total

description: Declarations in an except clause stay live
code:
base = 4
try:
    value = missing
except:
    value = base * 2
base = 5
value

description: An except binder shadows an outer name only inside its clause
Except Exception is a fixed word that a variable named Exception does not change
Except clauses run inside braced arrow functions
Except clauses run inside if blocks
